Questions

Asked, answered.

Is this legitimate medicine?
Yes — and verifiably. Licensed physicians in every state we serve, an accredited partner pharmacy dispensing under their own label, and a clinic built to the standard LegitScript certification requires. If a therapy isn't cleared under current law, it isn't offered here.
Will I definitely be prescribed something?
No. Treatment happens only where a licensed physician determines it's appropriate after reviewing your full intake. Sometimes the honest answer is a plan without a prescription — and if we're not right for you at all, you're refunded in full.
What happens at a checkpoint?
At week six and week twelve you report back, and your physician holds, adjusts, or stops the plan. Nothing renews on autopilot — a pathway continues because you both decide it should.
What does the monthly number include?
Everything on the pathway: physician care, your plan, both checkpoints, unlimited messaging, shipping — and treatment, if your physician prescribes it. No membership stacked on top, no surprise fees.
Can I really cancel in two clicks?
Yes — from your account page, no phone call, no retention script. We'd rather earn twelve months than trap one.

A pathway is a physician-guided care plan; treatment is prescribed only where a licensed physician determines it is appropriate after reviewing your intake and medical history, and any prescribed treatment is dispensed by our accredited partner pharmacy under their label. Compounded preparations, where prescribed, are not FDA-approved and are not reviewed by the FDA for safety or efficacy. Upperbound does not compound, manufacture or label medication, and is not a substitute for care from your primary physician. The pathway finder is an educational tool, not medical advice or a diagnosis.
